title: Prenuvo clinical team
description: A white section with an arced top over the section before it: a large teal-ink claim, a lead, a small italic footnote and a soft pill on the left, with three blurred light beams (blue, lilac, green) slanting in from the top right. Below, a row of seven portrait tiles that bleeds off both edges with every other tile dropped lower, then a centred grid of partner names in muted grey. The copy rises 96px into place, the portraits fade in one by one as you scroll, and the partner grid rises 64px.
notes: seven portraits fit the bleeding row best; each portrait slot takes an image (204×262 on desktop, 64×80 on phones, radius 12px) and shows a placeholder when empty
partner names are plain text; pass styled nodes for real logos
